description: 2-stage NAP curriculum on the exp414 architecture (E=32, residual_dim=384, d_v=16, 31.53M params target). Stage 1: NAP=3 with 2x tph everywhere (qkv 32, v 256, out 512, res 64), bs=4, 4000 steps, standard cosine+warmup. Weight transfer via outer-add merge (anchor_tree.merge_weight_tensor). Stage 2: NAP=6 at exp414's tph (qkv 16, v 128, out 256, res 32), bs=32, 3500 steps, RESET LR, NO warmup, pure cosine anneal. Adam state carried with AVG merge (m,v halved post-merge). Total compute = 65.5M tokens = same as exp413 bs=16. Reference: exp413 = 1.6414.
